Jamie: :wave: FYI — Tariffly sent invoice 2026-02-TAR-349 and it looks like we were billed for the pilot month AND the renewal period (overlap). Link: https://tariffly.example/invoices/2026-02-TAR-349. Who owns negotiation for credits and can we move them to consolidated quarterly billing?
Erin: Can you paste the invoice lines? need PO and contract mapping. If double-billed we ask for pro-rata credit but need PO/contract to back it. cc @Priya. :mag_right:
Jamie: invoice lines:
```
Item: Tariffly cloud credits - Pilot Feb 2026 - $8,450
Item: Tariffly committed renewal Mar 2026 - $12,300
Tax/fees: $0
Total: $20,750
PO: PO-98762
```
Priya: I will open a ticket. Playbook: request pro-rata credit for overlapped pilot month, propose consolidated quarterly billing (payments 1st of quarter). Need effective date and cashflow impact. Jamie — is May 1 OK to start quarterly?
Matt: Confirmed the late-Feb usage spike was our stress test, not production. I can attach runbook + logs for the dispute. Will include usage-query results.
billing-bot: Invoice 2026-02-TAR-349 (PO-98762) uploaded: https://files.redwood/invoices/2026-02-TAR-349.pdf :page_facing_up:
procurement-bot: Ticket created: TKT-5832 — "Tariffly: overlap billing dispute + request for quarterly consolidation". Assigned to Priya. SLA target 72h.
Priya: @Lena can we route this for expedited approval? Proposed remedy: (1) pro-rated credit >= $12,000 for overlap, (2) billing cadence amendment to quarterly starting 2026-05-01, (3) amendment signed by legal. Procurement will accept a credit note in lieu of refund.
Lena: Approved in principle. If Tariffly issues a credit note >= $12,000 and amends billing cadence, finance signs off. CC legal (legal@redwood.ai) on the amendment. Priya — route contract amendment + credit note to my inbox for final sign-off. :white_check_mark:
Jamie: I'll paste the stress-test logs and add a timeline to the ticket. Ping if Tariffly asks for anything else. :pray:
Priya: Tracking TKT-5832; target close date Apr 10 to avoid manual accounting headaches.
Jamie: Closing owners: @Priya (procurement), @Lena (finance approver), @Matt (usage verification).
